keen_edge.name: Keen Edge
keen_edge.description: Your army deals 8% more damage in its next battle.

homeward.name: Homeward
homeward.description: Teleport to your home town, if you still hold it.

town_gate.name: Town Gate
town_gate.description: Travel from one of your towns to another.

warfire.name: Warfire
warfire.description: Your army deals 20% more damage in its next battle.

stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
stoneskin.description: The army gains +2 defense until the end of the day.

warcry.name: Warcry
warcry.description: The army gains +2 attack until the end of the day.

unbroken_line.name: Unbroken Line
unbroken_line.description: +2 morale in battle for three days.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.description: Ranged troops deal 15% more damage for three days.

rootwalk.name: Rootwalk
rootwalk.description: Rough ground costs half its extra movement for two days.

red_harvest.name: Red Harvest
red_harvest.description: After each battle in the next three days, 15% of the fallen rise to fight again.

veil_of_shadows.name: Veil of Shadows
veil_of_shadows.description: Scouting costs no movement for three days.

dawnbreak.name: Dawnbreak
dawnbreak.description: Lifts the shroud in a wide circle around the hero.

call_the_pack.name: Call the Pack
call_the_pack.description: Calls 4 of your faction's first-tier troops to the army, +2 per Power.

horn_of_the_hold.name: Horn of the Hold
horn_of_the_hold.description: Every stack in the army gains 400 veteran experience.
